findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “As we see in the above Bible passage…”
findings.source_quote: “The mark this end-time ruler requires clearly signifies worship of the Beast, which would imply allegiance.”
findings.suggested_fix: Add the omitted HTML emphasis around “aanbidding” to preserve the source’s emphasis: “dui duidelik op aanbidding van die Dier”.

Translate the section label as “GEVARE VAN DIE HUIDIGE TYD” is acceptable only if it conveys the same sense; preferably use “GEVARE VAN ONS TYD” or “HUIDIGE GEVARE” to avoid suggesting only dangers of the present moment.
